description: Source code for the RequestedLayerState class in the Android SurfaceFlinger frontend, managing layer state requests including creation, merging, and transformations.

classes.name: RequestedLayerState
classes.description: Class representing the requested state of a layer in SurfaceFlinger, including properties, merge logic, and utility functions.

methods.name: RequestedLayerState
methods.description: Constructor initializing layer state from LayerCreationArgs.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges the state from a resolved composer state into this layer state, updating properties and change flags.

methods.name: getUnrotatedBufferSize
methods.description: Calculates buffer size considering transformations and display rotation.

methods.name: getTransform
methods.description: Computes the transformation matrix for the layer based on current state and display rotation.

methods.name: getDebugString
methods.description: Returns a detailed string representation of the layer state for debugging.

methods.name: getDebugStringShort
methods.description: Returns a short string summary of the layer state.

methods.name: canBeDestroyed
methods.description: Determines if the layer can be safely destroyed.

methods.name: isRoot
methods.description: Checks if the layer is a root layer.

methods.name: isHiddenByPolicy
methods.description: Checks if the layer is hidden by policy flags.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Returns the color of the layer, considering sideband stream and external texture.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer considering transformations and display rotation.

methods.name: getCroppedBufferSize
methods.description: Calculates the cropped buffer size based on crop rectangle.

methods.name: getBufferCrop
methods.description: Returns the crop rectangle applied to the buffer.

methods.name: getCompositionType
methods.description: Determines the composition type for the layer based on current state.

methods.name: reduce
methods.description: Reduces a window rectangle by an exclusion region.

methods.name: hasValidRelativeParent
methods.description: Checks if the layer has a valid relative parent.

methods.name: hasInputInfo
methods.description: Checks if the layer has input information.

methods.name: hasBlur
methods.description: Checks if the layer has blur effects.

methods.name: hasFrameUpdate
methods.description: Checks if the layer has a frame update pending.

methods.name: hasReadyFrame
methods.description: Checks if the layer has a ready frame.

methods.name: hasSidebandStreamFrame
methods.description: Checks if the layer has a sideband stream frame.

methods.name: willReleaseBufferOnLatch
methods.description: Determines if the buffer will be released on latch.

methods.name: clearChanges
methods.description: Clears the change flags for the layer state.
